document.about: Panasonic FP series PLC digest catalogue (28 pages). Its page titles are set at 17 pt over two lines and run past twelve words.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#160): a section title of more than twelve words was never a heading, however large it was set.

checks.issue: Page 5's 17pt title, fifteen words over two lines, was a paragraph.

element.text: Positioning control available with the more compact body with built-in 4-axis pulse outputs
